description: Authenticated synthetic admission on enabled simulator endpoints only. Server derives tenant, active source binding, event ID and occurrence time. Maximum encoded request size is 64 KiB, enforced by the service; per-source rate limit is 10 requests per second with tenant quotas.

requestId.description: Idempotency key scoped to authenticated tenant and resolved simulator binding. Reuse with different semantic input fails 409.

body.description: Validated against the selected canonical capability schema and enabled simulator profile. Unsupported fields are rejected.
